record.paper_title: FPT Suspects and Tough Customers: Open Problems of Downey and Fellows
record.original_question: Given finite posets P and Q, is P a chain minor of Q? Here P is a chain minor of Q if there exists a partial mapping ρ from elements of Q to elements of P such that for every chain C in P there is a chain C′ in Q for which the restriction of ρ to C′ is an isomorphism of chains from C′ to C.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let P = (V, <_P) and Q = (W, <_Q) be finite partially ordered sets. A chain in a poset is a totally ordered subset. Say that P is a chain minor of Q if there exists a partial map ρ : W → V such that for every chain C ⊆ V of P there is a chain C' ⊆ W of Q for which ρ is defined on all of C' and the restriction ρ|_{C'} : C' → C is an isomorphism of chains (i.e., an order-preserving bijection from C' to C with respect to the chain orders).

The Chain Minor problem is the following decision problem, parameterized by |P|:
- Input: a finite poset Q.
- Parameter: a finite poset P.
- Question: Is P a chain minor of Q?

Is this problem fixed-parameter tractable; that is, does there exist an algorithm deciding the problem in time f(|P|) · |Q|^{O(1)} for some computable function f?
artifact.status_search_result: The Chain Minor problem was shown to be fixed-parameter tractable. A deterministic algorithm running in time f(|P|) · |Q| log |Q| and a randomized algorithm running in time f(|P|) · |Q| (via color coding) were given, resolving the open question. The result appeared in the paper "Chain Minors are FPT" (arXiv:1304.5849, IPEC 2013 / Algorithmica 2018).

status_evidence.title: Chain minors are FPT
status_evidence.snippet: We give an algorithm that decides whether P is a chain minor of Q in time O(|Q| log |Q|) for every fixed P, solving an open problem from the Downey-Fellows monograph.
status_evidence.claim: Chain Minor parameterized by |P| is FPT.

status_evidence.title: Chain Minors are FPT (Algorithmica)
status_evidence.snippet: Journal version of the FPT algorithm for chain minor containment.
